P-ENCLOSURE.evidence: Garden is bounded by wooden walls on three sides, a building wall on the fourth, and a dark overhead canopy, creating a clearly defined enclosed outdoor room.

P-LAYERS.evidence: Garden features tall trees, mid-height shrubs, and a dense ground layer of moss and low plants, creating clear vertical layering and lush depth.

P-FOCAL.evidence: The stone water basin (tsukubai) on the left serves as a distinct focal point, with the stepping stones and gravel path leading the eye toward it and the surrounding plants framing it.
